description: You need to calculate the odds ratio for a case-control study using Epi Info 7's StatCalc module. StatCalc is already open. Navigate to the Tables (2x2 contingency table) calculator. In a foodborne illness outbreak investigation, 20 of 30 exposed persons became ill, and 5 of 25 unexposed persons became ill. Enter these counts in the 2x2 table: Exposed+Ill = 20, Exposed+Not Ill = 10, Unexposed+Ill = 5, Unexposed+Not Ill = 20. After entering the values, StatCalc will automatically calculate and display the odds ratio, 95% confidence interval, and chi-square p-value. Note the odds ratio value from the output.
